name: ask_chatgpt_web
description: Send prompts to ChatGPT Web via codex-chatgpt-web bridge with $0 API token costs. Supports deep reasoning, architecture design, code refactoring, and native image generation (returns Markdown image URLs). Supports models: chatgpt-web/pro (deepest reasoning), chatgpt-web/extra-high, chatgpt-web/high, chatgpt-web/medium (default), chatgpt-web/light (instant).

prompt.description: Question, coding instruction, or image generation prompt for ChatGPT Web.

cwd.description: Optional contextual working directory (defaults to process.cwd()).
